TC-20 U9 is not gated and quotes the UAT wording, and the matrix oracle is written from it; EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3 ask whether other wording may pass - if Quinn accepts the app's wording, only this check changes. FAIL (Hospital): the Post-Round tab shows a disabled button with a spinner, 'Finalizing Encounter Data…', still spinning 10 s later with nothing in flight (PostRoundTab.tsx canFinalize = status === 'note-ready'; any other status renders Loader2). The earlier summary that the tab 'shows only No note generated yet' was wrong. Record-only: the Note tab has no explicit error state (EFS U4b, gated TFA-92595).
Product issue: (1) Hospital and Nursing Home: when note generation fails on both models, the physician never sees 'Note not generated'; the Encounter tab says the formatted note 'couldn’t be generated' and the Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' although the encounter was completed. UAT Empty & Failure States state 4 / TFA-94745 state 4, TC-20 U9 (wording question open: EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3). (2) Hospital: after the failure the Post-Round tab shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' with a spinner that never ends (status stays 'seen'), so the physician is left looking at a busy state with nothing running. UAT 3.5 ('never left waiting with nothing') / OAT-03 ('never an endless spinner'); same screen as EFS U4b (gated TFA-92595).

descriptionHtml:
Decision D7 · P1 · Daniela

Wording when note generation fails: UAT asks for 'Note not generated'; the app uses other text (the endless 'Finalizing…' spinner is part of B27)

Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S24 Note generation fails on both models: the dashboard row never claims a note, the chart says 'Note not generated'

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 When a TC-20 action fails, the screens say so instead of looking current. If note generation fails (main and backup model), the chart shows 'Note not generated' with the dictation kept and the dashbo … (UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5; UAT OAT-03)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Standard fixture with the Hospital patient pre-rounded and the resident In Today and pending. The note-generation action is made to fail for the main and the backup model (answered with a failure at the Convex socket, the way apps/web/e2e/support/action-observer.ts trackActionRequests({ failFirst }) does, or a local p …

When Tab A shows the dashboard. In tab B type encounter text and tap Generate Note & Finish; wait for the app's failure state. Both care settings

Then Tab A never shows Note Ready on that row. Hospital may show Seen (the dictation was saved); Nursing Home stays Pending (Total 1, Pending 1). The chart shows 'Note not generated' with the encounter dictation kept

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT Empty & Failure States ('Note generation failed: "Note not generated" shown; dictation kept'), UAT 3.5 ('the physician is never left waiting with nothing'), OAT-03. The row badge is judged inside the row (runnerNotes.rowBadge). Nursing Home counts 1/1/0/0. Chart: 'Note not generated' and the typed dictation present. Written from the UAT wording, not from today's error copy

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 2 rows; to be decided by Daniela.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-94745 ready for qa

When note generation fails, the physician sees 'the note couldn't be generated… tap to retry' on the Encounter tab and 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' on the Note tab, not the UAT's 'Note not generated'.

Evidence: allure-results/9e250f4b…: generateNote fails at the socket for both models. The dashboard row never claims a note (pass), but the chart never shows 'Note not generated'. Hospital and NH say the note 'couldn't be generated… tap Generate Note & Finish to retry'. The Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' The wording question is open: EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3, and the OAT-03 knownGap reads 'awaiting Daniela'. The result is labelled UAT only (TC-20 U9); TFA-94745 state 4 holds the wording.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92595 in progress

In Hospital, after a failed note generation the Post-Round tab shows a 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' spinner that never stops, so the physician waits on something that is not running.

Evidence: Same result 9e250f4b…: in Hospital, the Post-Round tab still spins 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' 10 s after the failure, with nothing in flight (PostRoundTab canFinalize only when status is note-ready). Recorded in dev report §5 (copy observation); EFS U4b is gated on TFA-92595 AC 9 (explicit Note-tab error state).

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S24

Note generation fails on both models: the dashboard row never claims a note, the chart says 'Note not generated'

Tickets: none (UAT only)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (newspec-c/plan.json, automatable: yes): New Playwright spec per care setting: fresh account, Hospital patient pre-rounded (seeded) / resident In Today pending. Page A on the dashboard, page B (same account, second context) types the encounter text and taps Generate Note & Finish with ai/notes:generateNote answered as a failure at B's socket on every attempt (main + backup both fail). Then: A's row never shows Note Ready (row-scoped badge), NH counts Total 1 / Pending 1; B keeps the typed text in the box and stored, no note saved; the chart shows the UAT words 'Note not generated' (judged: TC-20 U9 quotes them, not gated; EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3 open); no spinner on the Encounter or the Post-Round tab 10 s after the failure (UAT 3.5 / OAT-03). Note-tab error state recorded only (EFS U4b, gated TFA-92595). — Socket-level failure of the one action and two pages on one account are both available; Generate is pressed only against a failing mock (no model call). Review: the literal wording is judged, not record-only; 'generate' stays in needs in the patch until Quinn confirms.

Detail:

Re-run 16:47 JST after review; both care settings fail. generateNote failed at B's socket (one call, answered at once). Pass: A's dashboard row sampled every 250 ms never showed Note Ready/Complete (Hospital: Pre-Rounded -> Seen, counts 1/0/1/0; Nursing Home stays Not Yet Prepped, counts 1/1/0/0); typed text kept in the box and stored; no note saved; the Encounter tab has no spinner 10 s after the failure. FAIL (both): the chart never shows the UAT words 'Note not generated' - Hospital Encounter tab says 'The encounter dictation is saved, but the formatted note couldn’t be generated and saved. Tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.', NH 'The visit dictation is saved, but the note couldn’t be generated. Check your connection and tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.'; the Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' TC-20 U9 is not gated and quotes the UAT wording, and the matrix oracle is written from it; EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3 ask whether other wording may pass - if Quinn accepts the app's wording, only this check changes. FAIL (Hospital): the Post-Round tab shows a disabled button with a spinner, 'Finalizing Encounter Data…', still spinning 10 s later with nothing in flight (PostRoundTab.tsx canFinalize = status === 'note-ready'; any other status renders Loader2). The earlier summary that the tab 'shows only No note generated yet' was wrong. Record-only: the Note tab has no explicit error state (EFS U4b, gated TFA-92595).

Product issue: (1) Hospital and Nursing Home: when note generation fails on both models, the physician never sees 'Note not generated'; the Encounter tab says the formatted note 'couldn’t be generated' and the Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' although the encounter was completed. UAT Empty & Failure States state 4 / TFA-94745 state 4, TC-20 U9 (wording question open: EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3). (2) Hospital: after the failure the Post-Round tab shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' with a spinner that never ends (status stays 'seen'), so the physician is left looking at a busy state with nothing running. UAT 3.5 ('never left waiting with nothing') / OAT-03 ('never an endless spinner'); same screen as EFS U4b (gated TFA-92595).

Evidence: 6 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: the step to write is a scripted Playwright spec in tools/qa-agent that makes its own fresh accounts and fails the note-generation action at the Convex socket (fault-ai), the way action-observer.ts does; dev has one shared account, no admin key and no action or socket mock (runner-contract…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
